name: get_github_activity
description: Read the website's current cached GitHub activity. The personal 365-date calendar through today in Asia/Kolkata and all-time owned public default-branch commit rankings have different scopes. Rankings include all authors and bots, sorted descending. Inspect errors and each source's fetchedAt; partial/stale/unavailable data must not be reported as a fresh zero. Refresh windows are 120 seconds; no GitHub commit is created by this read.
